mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or the rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate falls below 4.0% over a 3-month window, it signals a tight labor market that supports consumer spending growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand that accelerates corporate revenue growth, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of rising HOUST and RSAFS fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of rising industrial production (INDPRO > 102.5), supply chain constraints ease, reducing input costs and boosting corporate margins, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO > 102.5, or the rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 5.0%, it triggers a hawkish monetary policy response that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL yoy > 5.0%, or the rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real retail sales (RSAFS) over the past quarter signals robust consumer spending that drives corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS rises, or the rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in unemployment (UNRATE) and increases in employment (PAYEMS) signal a strong labor market that boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of declining UNRATE and rising PAYEMS fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases, or the interaction term's rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In the regime of high consumer confidence (RSAFS > 450,000), strong demand for goods accelerates corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS > 450,000, or the rank IC over the last 3 years is below 0.03.
